summary: Full-stack engineer with 8+ years of experience building and scaling web applications and cloud-native systems. Strong background in React, Node.js, API development, SQL & NoSQL, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS & GCP). Proven ability to deliver production-ready SaaS products, design resilient back-end systems, and collaborate cross-functionally in agile environments. Experienced across startups and enterprise-scale products, including AI-powered and serverless systems.

careers.title: Software Engineer
descriptions: Developed and scaled an AI-powered scheduling assistant SaaS as a full-stack engineer.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL, supporting core product workflows.
Deployed, managed, and scaled backend services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Firebase.
Built and maintained a React-based web portal, delivering personalized scheduling insights to users.
Integrated Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar APIs to analyze availability and generate optimal scheduling recommendations.
Implemented pub/sub messaging architecture for asynchronous post-processing and system resilience.
Containerized backend services with Docker, enabling a microservices-based architecture.

careers.title: Software Engineer
descriptions: Built and maintained the Radio.com Alexa Skill, supporting 1M+ active users across 300+ radio stations.
Developed backend logic using Node.js, DynamoDB (NoSQL) and Alexa SDK, delivering scalable voice experiences.
Created scheduled AWS Lambda jobs to refresh station catalogs via internal APIs.

careers.title: Agile Software Engineer
descriptions: Contributed to 5+ client-facing web and IoT projects as a full-stack engineer.
Built Node.js/Express APIs backed by PostgreSQL, supporting multi-platform consumption.
Implemented authentication services using AWS Cognito.
Modernized internal tooling and marketing platforms using React, Spring Boot, and SASS.

careers.title: Front-End Developer
descriptions: Developed features for a web-based financial platform using React, Ruby on Rails, and jQuery.
Built and optimized a SEO-focused marketing website to drive lead generation (MQLs).
Integrated Salesforce and Pardot to streamline marketing-to-sales workflows.
Developed custom HTML email templates for marketing campaigns.

careers.title: Web Application Developer
descriptions: Built web application platforms from scratch in a collaborative team environment.
Led front-end development of 50+ pages using Angular, JSP, and SASS, ensuring cross-device compatibility.
Supported backend development using Spring and MySQL.
